Topology: Built on a mesa with distinct slopes and stairways connecting upper and lower campus, but compact enough to cross on foot in 20 minutes.
Airport_Distance: 12 miles (~15-20 min drive) to San Diego International Airport (SAN).
Transit_Options: Direct MTS Green Line Trolley station on campus connecting straight to downtown and Mission Valley.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Dense, student-heavy suburban college area immediately surrounding campus; vibrant local spots with fast access to North Park, Hillcrest, and the beaches.
Housing_Status: Freshmen are clustered in vibrant residential halls near the center of campus, promoting strong social integration and quick access to academic quads.
Medical_Access: No primary on-campus teaching hospital, but positioned within 30 minutes of major research and medical powerhouses like UCSD Health and the Torrey Pines Mesa biotech cluster.

Topology: Flat, coastal campus built on a bluff directly adjacent to the Pacific Ocean; exceptionally bike-friendly with extensive dedicated paths and flat terrain.
Airport_Distance: 10 miles (~15 min drive) to Santa Barbara Municipal Airport (SBA).
Transit_Options: MTD local bus network serves campus heavily, though bikes and walking are the primary modes of transport for students.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Laid-back, vibrant beach town culture anchored by Isla Vista—a legendary, dense student community directly adjacent to campus packed with surf shops, local eats, and weekend energy.
Housing_Status: Freshmen are housed in diverse coastal residential halls, many offering ocean views and immediate beach access, fostering a unique surf-and-study atmosphere.
Medical_Access: No on-campus teaching hospital, but connected via regional transit and close proximity to Cottage Health medical networks and local biotech research centers.

Topology: Picturesque rolling campus tucked right against the foothills of the Rocky Mountains with gentle slopes, beautiful stone pathways, and iconic outdoor gathering quads.
Airport_Distance: 28 miles (~40 min drive) to Denver International Airport (DEN) via regional highway and direct airport bus lines.
Transit_Options: RTD regional bus system and the on-campus HOP transit route connect students seamlessly across Boulder and to local trailheads.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Vibrant college-town atmosphere anchored by the historic Pearl Street Mall and The Hill directly adjacent to campus, offering a lively mix of local coffee shops, eateries, and student culture.
Housing_Status: Freshman housing features unique residential academic programs (RAPs) that integrate dorm life directly with faculty and specialized classroom spaces.
Medical_Access: Campus medical services available via Wardenburg Health Center; proximal to Boulder Community Health facilities.

Topology: Flat, grid-based desert campus with iconic palm-lined pedestrian walkways (The Mall) that make walking and biking extremely easy across the entire layout.
Airport_Distance: 9 miles (~20 min drive) to Tucson International Airport (TUS).
Transit_Options: Sun Tran bus system and the modern Sun Link Streetcar running directly through campus and downtown Tucson.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Lively college community anchored by the vibrant Fourth Avenue strip and immediate proximity to downtown Tucson's dining, arts, and desert culture.
Housing_Status: Freshmen enjoy access to large-scale residential communities designed for social engagement, often featuring specialized pools, lounges, and proximity to campus dining.
Medical_Access: Full clinical access through Banner University Medical Center located adjacent to campus.

Topology: Flat urban-suburban campus layout featuring broad pedestrian malls, open green spaces, and integrated light rail access across the Tempe metro.
Airport_Distance: 7 miles (~10-15 min drive) to Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX).
Transit_Options: Valley Metro Light Rail station directly on campus alongside extensive local bus routes and free neighborhood circulators.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Massive urban college environment anchored by Mill Avenue's bustling nightlife, restaurants, and immediate access to the greater Phoenix metropolitan tech and entertainment scene.
Housing_Status: Modern residential villages offer a wide array of dorm styles, with many freshmen living in specialized residential colleges that cluster majors together.
Medical_Access: Integrated health services on-campus and close proximity to Valley-wide clinical networks.

Topology: Flat, historic, and beautifully shaded campus centered around 'The Oval,' with dedicated bike lanes and extremely easy pedestrian navigation.
Airport_Distance: 65 miles (~1 hr 15 min drive) north to Denver International Airport (DEN), with convenient Bustang shuttle options.
Transit_Options: MAX Bus Rapid Transit system running directly through campus, connecting Fort Collins from north to south.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Charming, bike-obsessed Colorado mountain town featuring historic Old Town Fort Collins with local craft breweries, coffee shops, and active outdoor communities.
Housing_Status: Freshman living is focused on a 'residential community' model, where students are grouped in historic or modern halls based on themes and academic interests.
Medical_Access: Clinical partnerships with UCHealth Medical Center of the Rockies and local regional clinics.

Topology: Compact, historic urban-campus layout featuring brick pathways, shaded quads (The Horseshoe), and relatively flat walking terrain.
Airport_Distance: 7 miles (~15 min drive) to Columbia Metropolitan Airport (CAE).
Transit_Options: COMET bus system and student-operated shuttles offering reliable connectivity across campus and downtown Columbia.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Classic Southern capital city setting anchored by the historic Five Points district, local eateries, and bustling SEC game-day culture.
Housing_Status: Freshmen are typically housed in historic or modern residential communities centered on The Horseshoe or dedicated freshman living-learning dorms.
Medical_Access: Integrated student health and access to Prisma Health hospital systems.

Topology: Hillside campus nestled against the Wasatch Range, featuring sloping terrain, scenic elevated views of Salt Lake City, and modern architectural clusters.
Airport_Distance: 10 miles (~20 min drive) to Salt Lake City International Airport (SLC).
Transit_Options: UTA TRAX light rail red line and campus shuttle network offering free transit for students across the Salt Lake valley.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Progressive, active urban-mountain setting right at the foot of world-class ski canyons, combining city culture with instant access to outdoor recreation.
Housing_Status: Freshman living is largely centered in modern residential complexes that provide community-focused living spaces and direct access to mountain recreation.
Medical_Access: University of Utah Health provides a premier on-campus teaching hospital and clinical research system.

Topology: Flat, historic Pacific Northwest campus featuring towering old-growth trees, brick architecture, and extensive dedicated bike paths.
Airport_Distance: 45 miles (~50 min drive) north to Eugene Airport (EUG) or 90 miles to Portland International (PDX).
Transit_Options: Corvallis Transit System (CTS) provides fareless local bus service across the entire city and campus footprint.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Classic, friendly Pacific Northwest college town centered around a vibrant downtown area filled with local coffee houses, independent bookstores, and microbreweries.
Housing_Status: Freshmen are housed in historic and contemporary residence halls across campus, often featuring unique community-building programs and easy access to academic buildings.
Medical_Access: Access via Good Samaritan Regional Medical Center and university-affiliated health clinics.

Topology: Rolling, picturesque Southern campus featuring historic brick buildings, beautiful oak-lined quads, and gently sloping terrain.
Airport_Distance: 55 miles (~50 min drive) west to Montgomery Regional Airport (MGM) or 100 miles to Atlanta (ATL).
Transit_Options: Tiger Transit bus system providing extensive complimentary transportation across campus and the local Auburn area.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Classic, tight-knit SEC college town centered around Toomer's Corner, legendary local dining, and unmatched community spirit.
Housing_Status: Freshman living is focused on residential communities that emphasize the 'Auburn Family' spirit, with many options in modern halls and dormitories near campus dining and student centers.
Medical_Access: University-affiliated medical support services and proximal to regional care providers.

Topology: Flat, highly walkable, and tree-lined campus with historic brick quadrangles and modern sustainability-focused facilities.
Airport_Distance: 10 miles (~15 min drive) to Eugene Airport (EUG).
Transit_Options: Lane Transit District (LTD) bus network offering free rides for UO students across the Eugene-Springfield area.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Vibrant Pacific Northwest college town known for its progressive culture, bike-friendly streets, local food carts, and intense athletic pride.
Housing_Status: Freshmen are housed in contemporary residence halls across campus, featuring strong living-learning communities and easy access to dining venues and academic quads.
Medical_Access: Integrated student health and proximity to Eugene-area medical and trauma centers.

Topology: Expansive, flat Southern campus featuring magnificent live oak trees, Italian Renaissance-style architecture, and picturesque lakes.
Airport_Distance: 9 miles (~15 min drive) to Baton Rouge Metropolitan Airport (BTR) or 75 miles to New Orleans (MSY).
Transit_Options: Tiger Trails campus bus service connecting students across all residential and academic zones.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Lively Southern cultural hub anchored by Baton Rouge's rich culinary scene, historic landmarks, and legendary SEC game-day festivities.
Housing_Status: Freshmen are housed in various residential colleges across campus, which integrate living spaces with academic support and social programs in a uniquely Southern campus setting.
Medical_Access: Access to comprehensive university medical clinics and proximity to Baton Rouge General health systems.

Topology: Flat, tropical South Florida campus layout featuring modern architecture, sunny outdoor courtyards, and close proximity to coastal waterways.
Airport_Distance: 26 miles (~30 min drive) to Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) or Palm Beach International (PBI).
Transit_Options: Boca Raton Tri-Rail shuttle service connecting students directly to regional transit systems and local commercial centers.
Neighborhood_Vibe: Upscale suburban South Florida setting situated just minutes from pristine beaches, local shopping districts, and vibrant coastal dining.
Housing_Status: Freshmen are typically housed in modern, apartment-style, or traditional residence halls that emphasize campus convenience and proximity to recreational facilities.
Medical_Access: Access to local university health services and proximal to regional Baptist Health networks.
